messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: axis.title.x = theme_blank() not working
parts:
Dear list members,

I am trying to put 2 different plots in one page (p1 and p2):

a= rnorm(20, 5.35, 1.6)
b = rnorm(20, 3.5, 1.1)
grupo = rep(c("a", "b"), c(20, 20)) 
cont = c(a,b)
cont
df = data.frame(cont, grupo)

sea = sd(a)/sqrt(20)
seb = sd(b)/sqrt(20)

dfplot = data.frame(sexo = factor(c("Machos", "Hembras"), levels=c("Machos", "Hembras")),
 punto = c(mean(a), mean(b)),
 ymin = c(mean(a) - 2*sea, c(mean(b) - 2*sea)),
 ymax = c(mean(a) + 2*seb, c(mean(b) + 2*sea)))
dfplot

pa = ggplot(dfplot, aes(x = sexo, y = punto, ymin= ymin, ymax= ymax, colour = sexo))
p1 = pa + geom_pointrange(size = 0.8) + xlab("Sexo") + ylab("Concentración contaminante (ppm)") + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,6)) + theme_bw() + opts(legend.position = "none")

dfdif = data.frame(
   dif= 2,
   punto = 1.72,
   ymin = 1.06,
   ymax = 2.39)

pb = ggplot(dfdif, aes(x = dif, y = punto, ymin= ymin, ymax= ymax, colour = "red"))
p2 = pb + geom_pointrange(size = 0.8) + opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank()) + geom_hline(yintercept=0.0, colour = "green", size = 1, linetype = 2) + coord_flip()  + ylab("Diferencia entre machos y hembras (ppm)") + theme_bw() + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,3)) + opts(legend.position = "none")

I have 2 questions:

Is the procedure in Hadley's book the only way to put 2 plots in a page?
If that is a yes, How can I enlarge the window (with) to have a better appearance of the plots?

In the second plot: "opts(axis.title.x = theme_blank())" is not working, why?

Best,

Manuel

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: axis.title.x = theme_blank() not working
parts:
I don't think it was coord_flip(), I think it was theme_bw() which has defaults for axis.x.text that are black. When you set your axis text with opts to theme_blank() and then had the call for theme_bw() afterwards it uses the last call to set the theme. At least that's my experience. Like you said Ista, putting your opts() call at the end fixes it. 

B
